The '''Toorja system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Toorja system was originally intended to be mentioned in the [[HK Manufacturing Plant]] level of the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', but was cut from the game. 

The system was rendered uninhabitable as a result of a conflict provoked by [[HK-50 series assassin droid|HK-50]] droids. Masquerading as [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], they deliberately mistranslated phrases on negotiations, preventing a peaceful agreement from being reached.
